analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.lede: How well agnts works for you over time: throughput, quality, where time goes, and what it costs your plan.
analytics.error: Could not load analytics. Try again.
analytics.emptyTitle: No data for this period yet
analytics.empty: Charts fill in as agnts picks up tickets and runs. Label a Jira issue or create a task to get started.
analytics.compared: Changes are compared with the previous {n} days. Green means better.
analytics.throughputSub: Tickets picked up and how they ended, per day
analytics.speedSub: Average minutes per ticket: agnts working versus waiting on you
analytics.turnsSub: Fewer turns means agnts finds its way faster and uses less of your plan
analytics.stopsSub: {n, plural, one {# stopped run in this period} other {# stopped runs in this period}}
analytics.modelsSub: Runs per model and how they turned out
analytics.noUsage: No usage readings in this period.
analytics.spendSub: Tokens {agent} used per day, input and output
analytics.spendStagesSub: Where the tokens went, costliest first
analytics.noSpend: No {agent} runs recorded in this period.
analytics.reposSub: Where agnts works best, and where it struggles
analytics.noRepos: No repository had tickets in this period.
analytics.hoursSub: When agnts works, summed over the period. Busiest hour: {hour}:00
analytics.noInsights: Not enough data for insights yet.
analytics.insightClaudeMd: Repositories with a CLAUDE.md finish in {gain}% fewer turns. Adding one to {repos} is the quickest win.
analytics.insightWaiting: {share}% of a ticket's total time is spent waiting on you. Reviews take about {review} min on average.
analytics.insightStopsTests: Most stopped runs ({n}) end on failing tests. Clearer acceptance criteria in tickets help agnts know when it's done.
analytics.insightStopsLimit: Plan limits stop more runs ({n}) than anything else. Fewer parallel runs or Haiku for summaries save usage.
analytics.insightNight: {pct}% of agnts's work happens between 22:00 and 07:00, while you're offline.
analytics.qualitySub: Tickets grouped by the prompt version of their first coding run. Compare versions to see whether a change to the agent helped.
analytics.noQuality: No coding runs in this period.
analytics.colFirstPassHint: Done tickets approved without a person asking for changes
analytics.colRoundsHint: Average change requests by a person per ticket that reached review
analytics.colCIRoundsHint: Average times red CI on the pull request sent the work back, per ticket that reached review (not counted in change rounds)
analytics.colFixesHint: Average times failing checks were sent back to {agent}
analytics.colSeriousHint: Share of reviewed tickets where agnts's review found a blocker or major problem
analytics.colFootprintHint: Share of changed files the analysis predicted
analytics.colRedFlagsHint: Skipped tests, removed assertions, silenced linters and the like found in the diffs
analytics.colSelfFixesHint: Times agnts's own review sent findings back to the coder before a person looked
analytics.insightMergeRate: Only {pct}% of agnts's pull requests were merged; {closed} were closed without merging. Check the Delivery tab for why.
analytics.insightSlowAnswers: Tickets wait about {hours} h for your answers to agnts's questions. Answering sooner is the quickest way to speed delivery up.
analytics.insightFollowUpsNoise: Only {pct}% of suggested follow-ups were accepted. Most of them are being dismissed.
analytics.insightFlakyJob: {job} in {repo} passed on re-run {n} times: it looks flaky. Fixing or quarantining it saves CI time.
analytics.typicalNote: Times are typical values (median): half the tickets were faster, half slower.
analytics.prOutcomesSub: agnts's pull requests opened in the period and what happened to them, merges and closes per day
analytics.mergeSpread: A typical pull request is merged in {p50}; the slowest one in ten takes {p90} or more.
analytics.staleSub: Pull requests nobody has merged or closed yet
analytics.noStale: No pull request has been open for more than a week.
analytics.cycleSub: Typical time from picking a ticket up to pushing and to merging, per day
analytics.cycleSpread: Pushed in {pushed} typically ({pushed90} for the slowest one in ten); merged in {merged} ({merged90}).
analytics.questionsSub: What agnts asked before coding, and how fast it got answers
analytics.slowestSub: The tickets that took longest from pick-up to push in this period, and where their time went
analytics.noSlowest: No ticket was pushed in this period.
analytics.kpiCiFixNote: From first failure to merged fix
analytics.kpiCiOwnNote: Red checks on agnts's PRs fixed before review
analytics.ciSub: New and fixed CI failures per day. {n} need attention now.
analytics.ciOffSub: CI watching is not set up. Turn it on for a repository and agnts triages red builds and fixes the ones caused by code.
analytics.ciClassesSub: What triage decided each failure was
analytics.ciNone: No CI failures in this period.
analytics.ciFlakiestSub: Jobs that failed and then passed on re-run most often
analytics.ciNoFlaky: No flaky jobs in this period.
analytics.kpiRulesLearnedNote: In use, of {n} suggested from tickets
analytics.kpiReflectionsNote: On changed or rejected tickets; {n} rules suggested
analytics.learningNote: How agnts learns from your feedback: fewer reviewer notes and more adopted rules over time mean it is working.
analytics.followUpsSub: Follow-up tickets agnts suggested in this period and what you decided
analytics.noFollowUps: No follow-ups were suggested in this period.
analytics.followUpSourcesSub: Suggested follow-ups by the step that found them
analytics.lessonsSub: Lessons written in this period; {n} were marked learned
analytics.reviewersSub: Who sends agnts the most feedback on code reviews
analytics.noReviewers: No reviewer notes in this period.
analytics.colRereviewHint: Times the reviewer asked agnts to review again
analytics.colDismissedNotesHint: Findings of agnts's review the reviewer dismissed
analytics.colManualHint: Notes the reviewer wrote by hand
analytics.kpiDaysAboveNote: {n} days above 80% of the session limit
analytics.colMergeRateHint: Pull requests merged, out of those merged or closed in the period
analytics.colQuestionsHint: Questions agnts asked per analysed ticket. Many questions point to a missing CLAUDE.md or rules.
analytics.colCiHint: CI failure groups that failed in the period
analytics.colScoreHint: 0–100: done first time 35%, merged 25%, no serious review finding 20%, few change rounds 20%. Recent versions score lower until their pull requests merge.
analytics.colCostMergedHint: What all the version's tickets cost, over the ones that merged
analytics.fewTickets: under 10 tickets: too few to compare
analytics.colPeopleEditedHint: Average share of agnts's lines people changed or removed before merging. Lower is better.
analytics.colRevertedHint: Tickets whose merged work people reverted
